settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultsNotice: Defaults do not overwrite existing user choices. Timezone changes apply to users without an override; language changes apply to new users and browsers without an explicit local language choice.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.notice: Read-only administrative inventory. Listing a workspace grants no access to its data. Ownership transfer is not available yet.
workspaces.sizeNotice: Size is the sum of recorded attachment bytes, including retained descendants in Trash. It excludes PostgreSQL tables, thumbnails, backups and unrecorded files; no disk scan is performed.
workspaces.empty: No live workspaces match this search.
workspaces.orphaned: Orphaned: no active direct user owner

login.title: Welcome to PandaTable
login.description: A shared home for your team's structured data.
login.notice: Sign in with an account created by your administrator. Workspace tools are coming next.

auth.homeNotice: You are signed in. Workspace navigation will arrive in a later task.
auth.changeNotice: Temporary passwords must be changed before using PandaTable. Changing your password signs out all your sessions.
auth.passwordPolicy: Use 8–32 UTF-8 bytes (Chinese characters may use multiple bytes). Passwords are not trimmed.
auth.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

admin.forcedNotice: Give this password to the user securely. They must change it at next sign-in. Resets sign out all their sessions.
admin.roleNotice: Changing a role signs out all of that user's sessions. At least one active administrator must remain. Changing your own role signs you out.
admin.statusNotice: Confirm the status change. All sessions are revoked; data and authorship are kept. Disabling your own account signs you out. At least one active administrator must remain.
admin.searchHint: Search username, email or display name

groups.title: Groups
groups.deleteNotice: Delete {name}? All its memberships and grants will be removed. Workspace data is kept.
groups.name: Group name

dashboard.title: System dashboard
dashboard.scope: CPU, load and RAM describe the host visible to this app (the Linux VM under local Podman), not container CPU capacity. App RSS and cgroup v2 memory are separate observations.
dashboard.policy: Refreshes every 10 seconds while visible. Metrics are cached for 5 seconds; logical file and backup totals are scanned at most hourly. Database connections include this collector. Disk space covers the configured data volume.
dashboard.stale: Refresh failed. The last successful snapshot below is stale; automatic retries continue while this page is visible.

reasons.initializing: Waiting for a second CPU sample

setup.title: Create your administrator account
setup.description: Use the setup token from the server log to secure this PandaTable instance.
setup.statusDescription: This PandaTable instance is ready for its first administrator.

spike.title: RevoGrid feasibility lab
spike.disclaimer: Synthetic data only. No database, query API, permissions or persistence. Changes live in this mounted prototype only (up to 5,000 cells). Client cache: at most 300 rows; request history: last 20. Timings are simulated browser-provider latency, not server performance.
spike.mobile: Below 768 px the grid is intentionally not mounted. Production mobile uses cards and a full-screen row editor (future M1 work), not this desktop spike.
spike.groupNotice: Built-in, collapsible grouping of a complete 100-row sample, read-only. This is NOT server-side grouping of 200k rows. Switching modes discards spike edits.
spike.instructions: Enter to edit; Escape to cancel; arrows/Tab to navigate; Shift+arrows or drag to select a range. Ctrl/Cmd+C/V uses TSV, including quoted multiline cells. Shift+Enter adds a note line; Enter saves. Ctrl+D fills down; drag the bottom-right fill handle. Edits require loaded cells. Clipboard needs browser permission/secure context; tablet gestures are experimental.
spike.noteHint: Shift+Enter for a new line; Enter to save
spike.loadError: The spike window could not be loaded. Unmount and remount to retry.
spike.editError: Edit rejected: use loaded writable cells, finite quantities, text up to 10,000 characters and at most 5,000 changed cells. No partial changes applied.
spike.pasteError: Paste rejected: malformed quoted TSV, more than 5,000 cells, or data outside the writable grid bounds. No changes applied.
spike.copyError: Copy rejected: select at most 5,000 loaded cells. No placeholder data is copied.
spike.stats: {total} logical rows · active page {page} · {rows} cached rows · {pending} pending · {edits} changed cells
